verdict.rationale: A long-time customer reports running dozens of purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules, which suggests native auto top-up. First-party docs only show building blocks: an internal-transfer API between checking, savings and treasury accounts, and balance-change webhooks and events that could drive custom low-balance alerting and scripted top-ups. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of native auto top-up or auto-transfer rules, a native low-balance alert feature with configurable thresholds, and any hands-on corroboration of alerting.
